_about: Draft gold labels for the W3 site profile, written by Claude Opus 5.5 in the Claude Code chat of 2026-10-02 from the same inputs the model sees (site text, principal activity, Maps category), before looking at the gpt-5.4-mini answers. Not ground truth until reviewed in Langfuse. Phrases follow the phrase rule in docs/WEB_STAGE_PLAN.md: no customer-location words, but a destination business keeps the place it sells. Revised 2026-10-03: quote_form renamed enquiry_form (callback requests count as forms and a form wins a tie with phone), tender moved to the wins_by_tender flag.

customer_type: Rooms, spa breaks, dining, weddings and gift vouchers for leisure guests; conferences are a side line.
conversion_action: Book a Room / Book The Spa / Book a Table throughout.
geography: A destination resort: guests travel from across the UK to the Lake District.
urgency: Breaks and spa days are booked ahead.
ticket_band: A two-night break or spa day is a few hundred pounds.
channel_fit: Destination searches plus visual, gift and lifestyle appeal.
google_category: The Maps listing (Resort hotel) is right.
00610641.phrase_note: Destination business: the place is part of what is sold, so place names stay in.
00610641.model_phrases_note: Good destination phrases (spa hotel lake district 14,800) mixed with zero-volume booking and facility phrases.
wins_by_tender: no
Customers come to it directly; nothing on the site about tenders or frameworks.

conversion_action: The hotel is temporarily closed; the bar and drawing room take walk-ins. When open, rooms are booked.
geography: A St James's luxury hotel: guests come from the UK and abroad.
urgency: Stays are planned; the bar is an evening out.
ticket_band: A night at a London luxury hotel.
channel_fit: Destination search plus visual luxury appeal.
01461396.phrase_note: Destination business. Lead flag: the hotel says it is temporarily closed for refurbishment.
01461396.model_phrases_note: 'hotel in london' (49,500) is far too broad for one St James's hotel and inflates the total.
wins_by_tender: no
Customers come to it directly; nothing on the site about tenders or frameworks.

customer_type: Workplace catering, venue hire and retail-space operations for organisations; the public cafes are run on behalf of landlords.

google_category: The Maps listing (Cafe) is one of its cafes, not the business.
05272723.model_phrases_note: Leads with 'cafe in london' (8,100), the wrong market; misses contract catering; most phrases have no volume.
wins_by_tender: no
Contract catering is often tendered, but the site names no tenders or frameworks; clients come through enquiries.
